description.raw: Himmel delivers 9 consecutive slashes on enemies in a designated frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), each dealing 60% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage. He then follows up with a massive sweep that deals 220% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies in front of him, plus extra true damage equal to 15% + 2% (SP-based) of the target's max HP. The extra true damage cannot exceed 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).

description.raw: Himmel dashes to the 2 enemies with the highest cumulative damage dealt, dealing 340% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage and knocking each enemy down for 2s. He then returns to his original position. Himmel remains while casting this skill.

He then returns to his original position.
Himmel remains while casting this skill.

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, if at least 1 Mage, 1 Tank, and 1 Support ally are within 1 tile of Himmel, he forms a Hero Party with himself and one ally from each class. Himmel inspires all party members, increasing their basic stats by 12% (ATK-based) + 1% (SP-based) and granting them a shared permanent shield equal to 1500% + 100% (SP-based) of Himmel's initial ATK. Active. Himmel strikes the target 4 times, each dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage, then converts 30% + 2% (SP-based) of the damage dealt into healing for all party members.

Increases the damage per strike to 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) when Himmel actively casts this skill.

description.raw: When a battle starts, blue-moon weed petals sweep across the battlefield, bestowing blessings on Himmel and his party members: Tank & Support: Increases their max HP by 150% (ATK-based) of Himmel's initial ATK. Mage & Himmel: Increases their ATK by 8% of Himmel's initial ATK. If Frieren is part of Himmel's Hero Party, Himmel places a flower wreath on her, permanently increasing both Himmel's and Frieren's Penetration by 30.
active: When a battle starts, blue-moon weed petals sweep across the battlefield, bestowing blessings on Himmel and his party members: Tank & Support: Increases their max HP by 150% (ATK-based) of Himmel's initial ATK.
Mage & Himmel: Increases their ATK by 8% of Himmel's initial ATK.
If Frieren is part of Himmel's Hero Party, Himmel places a flower wreath on her, permanently increasing both Himmel's and Frieren's Penetration by 30.

text: The Tank and Support members increase their max HP by 200% (ATK-based) of Himmel's initial ATK.
while the Mage member and Himmel increase their ATK by 10% of Himmel's initial ATK.
10s into a battle, the Blue-Moon Blessings sweep across the battlefield again, healing all party members for 40% of their max HP and removing all their debuffs.
For each surviving party member, increases Himmel's ATK by 12%.
The Tank and Support members increase their max HP by 250% of Himmel's initial ATK, while the Mage member and Himmel increase their ATK by 12% of Himmel's initial ATK.
